prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with whiplash after a hit while turning left. The patient had 7 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1043; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Nearly all findings rest on the patient's own pain reports; imaging and exam tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presents following a motor vehicle collision in which the patient's vehicle was struck while turning left. Reported symptoms consist of neck pain, stiffness, and headache consistent with a whiplash-type mechanism, and the mechanism of injury described is plausible for a collision of this kind. The patient attended seven visits over the course of care, including manual therapy, range-of-motion exercises, and home exercise instruction. Treatment followed a typical progression, with visit frequency reduced as symptoms improved and care tapered to a discharge-ready state. Nearly all reported findings rest on the patient's own account of pain and limitation; cervical imaging was unremarkable, and orthopedic and neurological screening examinations returned normal results. No prior injury to the cervical region is known to this provider. Billing records reflect single, non-duplicated charges for each service rendered. Prognosis is good with continued home exercise and as-needed follow-up.
